NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

1.
175 N. Azusa Ave ? (DR 2023-14, TPM 083919) ? The Planning Commission will consider a request for a Tentative Parcel Map, Minor Use Permit, and Design Review for the construction of 4 condominium units on an existing 7,075 square foot corner lot. Proposed units would consist of two three story structures totaling 6,238 square feet, including all garages. Proposed exterior material include stucco, tile, tile roofing, and vinyl windows for the modern Mediterranean design. The property is located in the CAZ (Azusa Avenue Corridor) zoning designation. The project is considered to be Categorically Exempt (Class 32) from CEQA.
F1 DR-2023-10 - FINAL STAFF REPORT

243 N. Azusa Ave ? (DR 2023-10, TPM 083839) ? The Planning Commission will consider a request for a Tentative Parcel Map, Minor Use Permit, and Design Review for the construction of 4 condominium units on an existing 7,075 square foot corner lot. Proposed units would consist of two three story structures totaling 6,700 square feet, including all garages. Proposed exterior material include Hardi siding, board and baton, shingles, stucco, and vinyl windows. The property is located in the CAZ (Azusa Avenue Corridor) zoning designation. The project is considered to be Categorically Exempt (Class 32) from CEQA.
